title: scan_from=old_len.saturating_sub(3) overlap is exact and documented
description: The 3-byte overlap when resuming SSE delimiter scans is provably correct: the longest delimiter (\r\n\r\n = 4 bytes) has a 3-byte prefix that could straddle a chunk boundary. The comment in the code explains this clearly. A future contributor might increase this 'just to be safe' or question why it is not larger. The value is exact and has a tight justification in the comment — do not change it without re-reading the delimiter table.
